---
title: "Events"
---

SEA-India organises technical seminars, workshops, conferences, webinars, panel discussions, site visits, student activities, research presentations, and Continuing Professional Development (CPD) programmes.

The Association aims to organise at least one technical programme every month, with every fourth programme as a full-day event and one major conference annually.
